titles: Shift Garlic & Herb Pork Fakeaway Burger
method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Split the wholemeal burger bun and toast the cut faces in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1–2 minutes. Set it on a clean plate.
Mix the measured garlic herb yoghurt in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling and refrigerated until assembly.

Slice the lean pork loin across the grain into cutlets about 1cm thick. After handling raw lean pork loin, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the pork cutlets over a medium heat for about 4–5 minutes on each side. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat and the juices are clear. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.
Put the lettuce and tomato in the toasted bun, add the cooked pork cutlets and the cold finishing sauce, then close the bun and serve immediately.
